:::{#exm-path-in-p}
#### Reachability is in P

Breadth-first search decides [PATH](#def-path).
It starts at $s$,
and, for each vertex it reaches, scans that vertex's row of the matrix
for neighbors not yet reached.
It handles each vertex at most once and scans each row in $O(m)$ steps,
so it takes $O(m^2)$ steps in all,
and it answers yes exactly when it reaches $t$.
The input has length at least $m^2$,
so this running time is $O(n)$ in the input length $n$,
and PATH is in P (@def-class-p).

:::
